articles.title: India's trade deficit hits 5-month high as imports surge
articles.description: India's trade deficit reached a five-month high as imports surged significantly. Exports showed continued growth, but were overshadowed by increased import costs. Analysts anticipate a widening current account deficit for the fiscal year.

articles.title: The Rs 7.50 lakh myth: Why employer's NPS contribution must be included in salary for claiming deduction under Section 80CCD(2)
articles.description: As the due date for filing ITRs for AY 2026-27 approaches, many salaried taxpayers are finding that the ITR utility does not allow deduction under Section 80CCD(2) unless the employer's NPS contribution is first included in salary.
